newsitem.title: USA: CCC to offer 8.45 mln bushels wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: CCC to offer 8.45 mln bushels wheat for sale.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corporation (CCC) of the U.S. Agriculture Department will offer nearly 8.45 million bushels of government-owned wheat for sale September 24, the Kansas City CCC office said.
Bids are due at the Kansas City, Mo, CCC office no later than 1430 CDT/1930 GMT September 24 and awards will be made no later than 1700 CDT/2200 GMT September 25.
The CCC wheat includes durum, spring wheat, hard red winter wheat and soft red winter wheat, and is stored in elevators from Texas to North Dakota.
